name: PYUSDx
oneLiner: PYUSDx is MoonPay's PYUSD-backed dollar token, redeemable 1:1 in PYUSD by eligible counterparties, with local freeze and mint controls.
collateral: PYUSD received by MoonPay Digital Assets Limited for 1:1 issuance; custody, segregation and independent PYUSDx liability reconciliation are undisclosed.
pegMechanism: Eligible MoonPay counterparties mint against PYUSD and redeem burned PYUSDx for the same quantity of PYUSD. Downstream holders have no direct redemption right without onboarding. Cross-chain transfers burn and mint through M0 Portal and LayerZero adapters.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: MoonPay issues a distinct contractual token backed by PYUSD; eligible-counterparty redemption is 1:1 in PYUSD. Holder terms deny ownership or trust interests in specific reserves, so this is a core fiat-cash instrument with PYUSD collateral, not a direct escrow receipt or tracked variant.
